title: Two Sessions of Coach-Delivered Core Transformation for Distress and Well-Being
official: Two Sessions of Coach-Delivered Core Transformation for Psychological Distress and Well-Being in Community Adults: A Randomized Waitlist-Controlled Trial
summary:
The goal of this study is to learn whether two sessions of Core Transformation (CT), a guided coaching process, reduce psychological distress in adults. The study will also examine well-being, daily functioning, changes in participants' self-chosen issues, and whether any changes last over time.

The study compares two groups of adults randomly assigned to different start dates for the same two CT coaching sessions. One group receives the sessions earlier (immediate treatment), while the other group waits until after completing an assessment before receiving the sessions (delayed treatment or waitlist).

The main questions are:

* Does receiving two Core Transformation sessions reduce psychological distress, measured by depression and anxiety symptoms, compared with waiting to receive the sessions?
* Do changes in psychological distress, well-being and functioning last over time?
* Do participants experience changes in the personal issue they choose to work on?

Participants will:

* Be aged 18 or older and live in the United States.
* Complete online informed consent, screening and a baseline survey.
* Be randomly assigned to the immediate treatment group or delayed treatment (waitlist) group.
* Receive two individual Core Transformation coaching sessions of approximately 90 minutes each, delivered online over Zoom, 7-10 days apart (up to 11 days if needed).
* Agree to have both coaching sessions video-recorded.
* Complete online surveys at baseline, at the primary assessment, after receiving CT, and at approximately 3, 6 and 12 months after their second CT session.

Participants in the immediate treatment group receive their coaching sessions before the primary assessment. Participants in the delayed treatment group complete the primary assessment before receiving their coaching sessions. Both groups are offered the same two CT sessions.

The study is conducted entirely online by Andreas NLP and is open only to adults living in the United States.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Aged 18 or over and lives in the United States
2. Able to read, speak and understand English well enough to complete the surveys and CT sessions.
3. Has internet access and a device that can run Zoom, and is able to attend two online sessions of about 90 minutes, about one week apart.
4. Gives informed consent online.
5. Agrees to have both CT sessions video-recorded

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Severe range at screening, or at the re-check before randomization: PHQ-8 of 20 or more, or GAD-7 of 15 or more.
2. Started, stopped or changed psychotherapy or psychiatric medication in the past 3 months. (Stable care that started earlier is not an exclusion.)
3. Has been guided through the Core Transformation process before, or has guided themselves through it.
